title: PHASE A2 (HEADLINE generalization; GATED on exp4403 localizer_genuinely_beats_position_only==true) -- does the DECONFOUNDED localizer GENERALIZE: (a) cross-domain to the GAP-4 ARC split + a held-out FoVer template family, and (b) agree with an INDEPENDENT typed first-error taxonomy monitor (arXiv:2603.25412 'Reasoning Safety Monitor')? exp4403 (gated) shows a real-intervention localizer that beats the content-blind position-only baseline on a held-out FoVer family. Before it graduates to a cross-domain headline, (1) build an INDEPENDENT typed first-error discriminator (a typed reasoning-vulnerability taxonomy as a SEPARATE label/audit channel) and compare its onset labels with the localizer's -- require a disagreement analysis (per-type false-positive + domain-competence) before accepting an earliest-error claim; (2) test cross-domain generalization (does the localizer's content-dependent advantage hold on GAP-4 ARC, where the mechanic differs from FoVer-math?). Emit localizer_generalizes_typed BARE bool := (the deconfounded localizer beats the position-only baseline CI95-excl-0 on >=1 NON-FoVer domain AND its onset labels agree with the independent typed-taxonomy monitor above chance, with per-type FP reported). verifier_is_oracle=false. A pass = the oracle-distinct localizer is a cross-domain capability (north-star §0 step 2); a fail = it is FoVer-family-bound (logged as a missing-verifier gap, the localizer is domain-narrow). This DIAGNOSTIC reuses exp4403's localizer; no new label infra, no live training. NO TRM training; CPU-offline.
